## What you should be able to do tonight

- Write the five relationships of week 5 from memory: log-simple conversion, time aggregation, cross-sectional aggregation, the drag, and the square-root rule with its correction.
- State which of the five you were least able to reproduce, and fix that one.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed: ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, then 3/8, 5/16 and 1/11 as decimals. Fifth sitting. Compare against the plot you made last night.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The urn canon: an urn has 5 red and 7 blue balls; you draw 3 without replacement. Probability all three are the same colour? Do it two ways, by counting and by the multiplication rule, and check they agree.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Variance by conditioning: you roll a die, then flip that many coins. What is the expected number of heads and its variance? Use the law of total variance and say out loud which term is which.
:::
:::
